Opportunity Details

Teaching & Mentoring Volunteer-Mumbai

Dharma Bharathi Mission (An Initiative of Navsrushti International Trust) | http://www.dbmindia.org

As a Teaching & Mentoring Volunteer, you will support school students by conducting engaging learning sessions within the school, assisting with academic concepts, and encouraging active participation in the classroom. Working alongside the school and DBM India team, you will help create a positive, inclusive, and supportive learning environment that fosters confidence, curiosity, and overall student development.

Education

Age Minimum (with Adult): 18+, Minimum Age:18+, Skills: Teaching
